resource_rule.measure: Sum of libproc resident bytes rounded up per member to KiB over owned process group; sampled, not continuous peak
resource_rule.failure: Stop above 40 GiB, after three consecutive unavailable observations, or immediately after a sampler timeout; retain all partial evidence. Unknown native/group exit blocks every subsequent child.

semantics.schedule: Graph seed then case then adjacent reference/compressed children, with fixed sampler seed 1801. Graph seed two reverses case order and variant order. Six timed repetitions balance solver positions within every child.
semantics.timing_boundary: Original tuple-input/native-result boundaries. KKT and both Boruvka continuations time problem conversion and temporary input destruction; returned-result validation/destruction are outside the interval. UTC/CPU envelopes are slightly wider than steady elapsed.
semantics.comparison: Pair all six reference/compressed solver durations by case, graph seed, fixed sampling seed and repetition; compare KKT directly with all five controls within each variant. Case medians pool all twelve paired ratios; each of the two graph realizations uses six. The single sampling marginal equals the case median and is not an independent realization. Both clocks, all trials and losses remain included.
semantics.purpose: Compress verifier endpoint-to-ancestor requests by lower vertex and ancestor depth. Scalar sampling, RNG stream, retained-edge contraction, direct-Edge queries and all seven non-verifier objects are fixed; only verifier.o changes. Reference and candidate should preserve exact results and the planned work identities. No reserve, sampler, unrelated lifetime or baseline changes, and no historical timing pooling.
semantics.clock_semantics: Steady elapsed and process CPU remain separate. Clock flags are descriptive, never a reason to trim or correct data. UTC reversals remain in raw endpoints. Power-log correlation uses actual Sleep/Wake/DarkWake transitions; Wake Requests do not close sleep.
semantics.power_semantics: No verified sleep inhibition is inferred. An absent logged overlap is not proof of an awake, quiet host. Power auditing is post-capture only and never launches pmset automatically.
semantics.certificate_scope: Independent native reference certificate once per child, then exact unique-MST ID/tuple validation for every warmup and timed call.

power_audit.limitation: External log provided; query success/retention coverage not established here. No raw private power events are copied into analysis.

aggregation: Pair all six reference/compressed solver durations by case, graph seed, fixed sampling seed and repetition; compare KKT directly with all five controls within each variant. Case medians pool all twelve paired ratios; each of the two graph realizations uses six. The single sampling marginal equals the case median and is not an independent realization. Both clocks, all trials and losses remain included.
